title: Income Support Levy Act, 2013 (Act No. XXII of 2013)
found: Enacted 0.5% wealth levy on net movable wealth over Rs 1 million; repealed by Finance Act 2014.

title: Public Support for Wealth and Progressive Taxes in Pakistan
body: International Centre for Tax and Development
found: Nationwide survey of 7,500 Pakistani adults finding 42% support for a general wealth tax.
